attachments.text:
Augmented World Expo is a global event series with conferences in the USA, EU, Asia, Israel, worldwide meetups, workshops and an always on platform: awe.live . 

AWE is on a mission to drive adoption of AR. We do this by bringing together the spatial computing industry including developers, creators, founders, product leads, C-level executives, media and analysts, to help it succeed

Upcoming Conference & Expos:
AWE Academy courses
AWE Nites - locally organized meetups

AWE USA 2023 | Santa Clara, California | May 31 - June 2, 2023
AWE Asia 2023 | Singapore | August 30-31, 2023
AWE EU 2023 | Vienna, Austria | October 24-25, 2023
AWE.LIVE | Non-Stop Streaming of XR Content

What the press has to say about AWE:
"The most essential AR/VR conference and expo" ~ Forbes

“The Consumer Electronics Show of the Future. The increasingly Near Future” ~ USA Today

"AWE sets the example for what an AR/VR conference should be" ~ Next Reality

Learn more at <http://www.awexr.com|www.awexr.com>
